heroHeadline: Day 657: La Mayiza Sombrero Attack on Rocha Moya's Culiacán Home; Sheinbaum 'Not a Protectorate'; USMCA Clock Ticking
heroSubtitle: 657 days of cartel civil war — May 9: A La Mayiza gunman wearing a sombrero (faction signature) opened fire at former Governor Rocha Moya's uninhabited Las Quintas residence in Culiacán, firing dozens of rounds in under 10 seconds — a calculated psychological signal 10 days after Rocha Moya's historic SDNY indictment for Chapitos drug conspiracy. Reports indicate Sheinbaum, Rocha Moya, and former President AMLO met over the weekend to coordinate a response. May 10: Sheinbaum issued her sharpest sovereignty statement — 'We are not a protectorate. We are not a colony.' FGR formally ruled US extradition documentation lacks 'sufficient probative elements' and launched its own investigation. May 11: USMCA June 2026 mandatory review looms as Trump reviews all 53 Mexican consulates for potential closure — Mexico's strongest economic pressure point yet. Running conflict toll: ~2,425+ since Sep 9, 2024; March 2026 marked the lowest monthly count (79–121) since the war began.
